title: Some Trivial Links
text:
Trivia Nut is the hardest trivia game I’ve found and is consistently surprising. Questions range from: directors of movies, capitals (with an focus on African nations), translating words from German to French, and random calculations.
What The Day is a fun website to learn John Conway’s doomsday algorithm with which one can be give an arbitrary date and quickly determine what day of the week it fell on.
SQLBolt and RegexOne are good refreshers for using SQL and Regex and are pretty fun for first time users.
CSS Diner was helpful to learn how to style this website!
Codepip mostly a bookmark for me to come play these games at some point.

title: Some Trivial Links
text:
The internet – what a place!

Detexify A classic! Draw a LaTeX symbol and find its command. No more “google find me a squiggly ‘r’ shape with a line here…”. This palette style reference is helpful too: LaTeX Editor.
Guide to GeoGuessr teaches you all the tricks to GeoGuessr.
Best for Puzzles: Cryptic Crosswords my reference for cryptic crosswords.
CFOP I only know 2-look CFOP.
Markdown This was open while I wrote this page.
Chinese Character Stroke Order Shows you how to write a Chinese character.

title: Sophia Hatsell
text:
Hello! I am currently a graduate student at the USC Department of Mathematics. I graduated from UCLA in 2025 with a Bachelors in Mathematics and a Specialization in Computing.
Before I started grad school, I was a Technical Solutions Engineer at Epic Systems on the Patient Experience team.
